title: Complete feature/table cross-links (tableRefs) and de-flatten prose
description: Deficiency #7. Schema supports feature.data.tableRefs (comments cite feature:cleric:destroy-undead -> table:destroy-undead) but exported records show no tableRefs, and feature:cleric:destroy-undead still embeds the flattened table text in its description. Fix: every feature/rule/spell/magic-item that owns or references a table links it explicitly via tableRefs (or equivalent). If a table is separately emitted, primary playable description omits the flattened rows OR preserves them only under a deliberate sourceText field. Re-freeze gates: table links complete (no important standalone table unreachable from owner) AND no duplicate table linearization in primary prose unless deliberately modeled under sourceText.
notes: STALE-SNAPSHOT FINDING (from o9bd.11 verification 2026-06-28): feature:cleric:destroy-undead (the deficiency #7 headline example) is ALREADY fixed in the committed pack — it has tableRefs and no flattened CR table. BUT only 2 features total carry tableRefs, so broad table-link completeness work remains. The table-link/de-flatten gate was deferred from o9bd.11 to this bead (it's this bead's own acceptance check). Re-verify committed pack before scoping.
close_reason: All children (8.1/8.2/8.3) complete: table-link completeness + reachability gate landed; de-flatten already enforced at import. PRs #358/#359 merged, #360 open.
